projectDescription: Cloudy is a web-based proxy platform that lets users browse the web freely, play games, and run apps — all from within a clean, customizable browser-like interface.
keyFeatures: Web proxy supporting Scramjet, Ultraviolet, and Dynamic transport modes
About:Blank cloaking to hide the site in a blank page
Tab Cloaker — disguise the tab title and favicon as common school tools
Built-in multi-tab browser system with navigation controls and inspect element
Wide library of games and apps accessible from within the interface
Now.gg and Geforce NOW cloud gaming support
Multiple visual themes including Catppuccin flavors and custom color schemes
Customizable search engine (Brave, Google, Bing, and more)
Panic Key — instantly redirect to another site with a single keypress
Optional password protection for self-hosted instances
Save data export and import for seamless site migration
publicApiSurface: GET / — Home page (search / proxy entry point)
GET /e/:source/* — Proxied external asset endpoint (cached 30 days)
GET /ca/* — Bare server routing (WebSocket/HTTP proxy transport)
